title: Japanese-Style Dorayaki Breakfast Pancakes
description: A traditional Japanese dessert turned into a delicious breakfast treat. Soft, fluffy pancakes filled with sweet red bean paste.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour and sugar.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and water.
3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
4. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
5. Grease the pan with a small amount of vegetable oil.
6. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan.
7. Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
8. Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
9. Serve the pancakes with red bean paste and enjoy!
